title: One-off lattice signal mapper
content:
Purpose:
A quick, lightweight mapping of ephemeral signal owners and short-run coverage for the next three release days. This started as a 10-min ask in the cross-org cadence (Slack #ops-handoff). Goal is to produce a single-pane view teams can consume when triaging weekend surges and small routing failures. Not a canonical roster — more of a tactical tidy for ~72h.

Top-line (TL;DR):
- Immediate coverage looks OK for US/EMEA but holes in APAC off-hours if model fallbacks trigger.
- Two runtime routes (embed-small, gen-lowlat) have overlapping owners and ambiguous escalation — we should pair or split.
- Quick wins: add explicit fallback owner for embed-small and document golden-runbook link.

Snapshot table (hand-compiled from tickets, on-call notes, and recent latency samples):
REGION | PRIMARY OWNER | BACKUP | ROUTES COVERED | EST. BURNT CAPACITY (tokens/min) | NOTES
US-W | Marcus Chen | Diego Ramirez | gen-lowlat, rerank | 28k | Marcus on PTO 3/12-3/13 nights; Diego cover after 22:00 PT
US-E | Aisha Patel | (automated fallback) | gen-lowlat, gen-cost | 33k | automated fallback to gen-cost at 80% latency burn; verify config (ENG-4123)
EMEA | Lena Sørensen | Marcus Chen | embed-small, rerank | 11k | EMEA on-call overlapping with Marcus mornings; watch prefix-cache miss rate
APAC | (unassigned) | (unassigned) | embed-small | 6k | NO primary — recent surge pattern at 02:00 JST; raising short-term cadence
GLOBAL | Infra Oncall | SRE Lead | control-plane | n/a | control plane SLA 99.9% - raise to SRE if cross-region failure

Quick findings / notes to self:
- embed-small route: two recent incidents (INC-20394, INC-20412) related to quantized variant rollbacks. No explicit fallback owner in page. Add fallback owner + contact.
- gen-lowlat has automated cost fallback but not documented for customer-facing routes; product wants clearer RTT vs cost thresholds.
- Recent prefix-cache misses correlate with a deploy on 2034-03-09 (runtime PR #918). Marcus has follow-up.

Action items (short, assign and close within 48h where possible):
- Assign APAC primary for embed-small (owner candidate: Shu Tanaka). POC: Marcus. Target: 2034-03-15 EOD. (ticket: JIRA-OPS-1284)
- Add explicit fallback owner in runbook: create short para + Slack alert mapping. Owner: Aisha. Target: 2034-03-14.
- Validate automated fallback thresholds for gen-lowlat (product + eng sync). Owners: Product-hosted-api + Eng-runtime. Meeting: 2034-03-13 09:00 PT.
- Small playbook: one-pager for weekend on-call triage (2 pages max). Owner: Lena. Draft: 2034-03-16.

Open questions / risks:
- If APAC primary not assigned, do we auto-route APAC traffic to US-E or apply rate-limits? (risk: increased latency, SLO fallout)
- Is there a low-cost quantized variant we can use for embed-small as temporary fallback? Product asked but needs model team input.
- Does billing alerting (cost-per-token spike) trigger early enough for infra to preempt routing changes?

Short-run monitoring hacks (manual checks):
- Hourly: quick sampling script (sample-requests.sh) from each region to gen-lowlat and embed-small; paste 50 responses into the shared log. Responsible: whoever is covering that region that hour.
- Twice-daily: prefix-cache miss rate snapshot (>=1% sustained for 30m = escalate).

Stakeholders / contacts (fast list):
- Product: Aisha Patel (product-hosted-api)
- Runtime eng leads: Marcus Chen (serving-runtime)
- Observability: Lena Sørensen (observability)
- SRE/Infra: Diego Ramirez (infra)
- APAC model lead (tentative): Shu Tanaka (cc in Slack thread)

Related threads / refs:
- Slack: #ops-handoff thread ts 2034-03-09 18:12 — contains sample logs and immediate asks.
- Confluence: Lattice Signal Playbook (linked above) - needs a 2-line summary at the top for quick triage.
- Github: runtime PR #918 — rollback notes and perf traces attached.

Next steps (this doc is intentionally lightweight):
- Aisha to add fallback owner text to the playbook + post to #ops-handoff (due 3/14).
- Marcus to propose APAC owner and confirm coverage windows (due 3/15).
- Lena to draft the weekend playbook (2 pages) and share for 1-hr review.

Notes to self: keep this doc ephemeral and prune after 72h from last update (otherwise it becomes noise). If there are repeated occurrences, move to canonical playbook and escalate to permanent on-call changes.

Changelog (tiny):
- 2034-03-10: initial capture (Aisha)
- 2034-03-12: added APAC gap and PR linkage (Marcus)
- 2034-03-14: assigned backup checklist and playbook owners (Lena, Aisha)

-- end --
